text:
maya: Quick runbook sync — I ran a cadence-level synthesis of recurring postmortem signals for the last 6 months. Three dominant recurrence buckets: (A) KV cold cascades on multi-model swaps, (B) autoscaler oscillation on rapid burst->cooldown, (C) short-lived inter-region retransmits causing retries. Proposing owners, KPIs, and a two-phase plan.

devon: Nice. What windows and counts did you use?

maya: Window = 2025-10-01..2026-03-31. Counts: KV-cascade=19, autoscaler-bounce=14, region-retransmit=8. Query I used (sanitized):```sql
SELECT root_cause, COUNT(*) cnt
FROM incidents
WHERE created_at BETWEEN '2025-10-01' AND '2026-03-31'
AND tags @> ARRAY['postmortem']
GROUP BY root_cause
ORDER BY cnt DESC;
```

hsu: For KV cascades — any model-family skew or tenant hotspots?

maya: Mostly large-context families (LlamaX, RedLM-XL), skewed to Dedicated and some Private VPC customers doing rapid in-session swaps. No single tenant dominates.

ops-bot: ops-bot created ticket INF-7001 "KV cold cascade playbook + counters"

anya: Proposed owners: anya -> KV counters & adaptive warmup (PoC 9d, mitigation 18d), devon -> autoscaler stability RFC + canary (RFC 6d, canary 12bd), ricardo -> region-retry smoothing + obs (canary 8bd). Agree?

devon: I can take autoscaler. Plan: add short smoothing window (30s), add a scale-down velocity cap (max 20%/min), and detect swap.events to pause aggressive scale-downs. RFC + perf run in 6 workdays. Need perf-replay.

ricardo: I'll own inter-region retries. Plan: jittered backoff + per-route circuit breaker + sticky routing for 30s on transient loss. Canary to 10% regions then 40%. Target initial canary in 8 business days.

anya: KV plan: add metrics.kv.cold_start_count (sharded model_version+deployment) and heartbeat kv.hit_ratio.v2. PoC for adaptive warmup (budgeted queue per deployment) in 9 days; full mitigation + CI smoke in 18 days. Concern: warmup load must be budget-capped.

maya: Good call. Also proposing two KPIs to measure success: (1) recurrence reduction >=60% over 30 days after mitigation, (2) reduction in mean swap-tail95 latency by 30%.

ops-bot: ops-bot linked INF-7001, INF-7002, INF-7003 to epic INF-7099 "recurrence-playbook-sprint-2026-q1"

devon: Small ask: add a canary traffic replay for autoscaler validation (10m real-traffic replay) and a small perf harness job. I'll coordinate with perf infra.

anya: For metrics cardinality: we'll TTL per-model counters to 90d and only persist top-K models by swap-volume. Others will be sampled and surfaced via aggregation. Adding this note to INF-7001.

ricardo: Observability notes: add swap.tail95, route.retry_rate, and per-swap-event counter. Also add an alert when kv.hit_ratio < 0.5 for >30s on Dedicated pools.

maya: Runbook changes I propose: a) immediate mitigations (2-week sprint): KV counters + smoke, autoscaler hysteresis + limited canary, retry backoff tweak; b) medium-term (30d): adaptive warmup rollout, ramped canaries, post-deploy regression tests.

devon: I'll include a rollback play in the RFC: - immediate rollback if swap.tail95 > 2s for 2 consecutive 1-minute windows OR kv.hit_ratio < 0.4 for >60s.

hsu: Who handles customer comms for Dedicated tenants if we need to block promos or gate model weight rollouts?

maya: ricardo + cs should coordinate. I'll own the retro one-pager and tag customers flagged in past incidents. ops-bot: schedule comms owner reminder.

ops-bot: reminder-bot scheduled a follow-up checkpoint in #incidents for thread 2170001111 in 14 days

anya: Action recap (tickets + owners + targets):
- INF-7001 anya: KV counters + adaptive warmup + CI smoke (PoC 9d, mitigation 18d)
- INF-7002 devon: Autoscaler RFC + perf canary + rollback play (RFC 6d, canary 12bd)
- INF-7003 ricardo: Inter-region retry smoothing + obs + comms (initial canary 8bd)
- INF-7099 maya: Epic + runbook + customer-tagging + retro one-pager (checkpoint 14d)

devon: I'll ping perf infra for replay access. If we hit quota, we can run a scaled synthetic traffic replay instead.

hsu: Small implementation note: for adaptive warmup, prefer background lightweight KV population using sampled prefixes rather than heavy synthetic replays; reduces extra load. I'll add details to INF-7001.

maya: Perfect. Please update tickets with PR links, smoke job configs, and perf-replay IDs. We'll validate success against the KPIs and include a short summary in the next quarterly incident review. Closing until checkpoint. :white_check_mark:
